questionText:
Read the following case study and answer the question:

"Dr. Radhika, a licensed university psychologist, was providing psychotherapy to Tarun, a 21-year-old engineering student. Tarun was severely distressed following an acrimonious breakup with his classmate, Sneha. During their fourth session, Tarun became intensely agitated, clenched his fists, and stated: 'Sneha betrayed me and humiliated my family. I have purchased an unlicensed firearm and three rounds of ammunition. Tomorrow after our physics lab at 4:00 PM, I am going to shoot her in the parking lot and then end my own life.' Dr. Radhika attempted to de-escalate Tarun, but he abruptly walked out of the clinic. Dr. Radhika faced an urgent ethical and legal dilemma regarding the boundary of client confidentiality versus the preservation of human life."

In light of the landmark Tarasoff legal ruling and professional ethical codes, what is Dr. Radhika's mandatory legal and ethical obligation?

options.text: Wait until the next scheduled session next week to ask Tarun if he carried out the act
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: Send an anonymous email to the student union discussion forum
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: Immediately notify university security/police and warn the identifiable potential victim (Sneha) to prevent lethal harm (Duty to Warn / Protect)
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately identifies the verified NCERT concept for Ethics in Psychology.

options.text: Maintain absolute confidentiality and refrain from contacting anyone under all circumstances
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT principles for Variations in Psychological Attributes (Ethics in Psychology):
Immediately notify university security/police and warn the identifiable potential victim (Sneha) to prevent lethal harm (Duty to Warn / Protect)

Detailed Context:
The landmark Tarasoff v. Regents of the University of California ruling established that therapists have a 'Duty to Protect': when a client poses an imminent, serious threat of violence to a foreseeable victim, confidentiality must be breached to warn the victim and alert law enforcement.
Hence Option A is correct.

Therefore, option (C) is the correct answer.
